current_point.claim: 提出一种结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体模型Museformer，其中细粒度注意力使每个token直接关注到与音乐结构最相关的小节的所有token，粗粒度注意力使每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息而非每个具体token。
current_point.claim_en: Propose Museformer, a Transformer variant with fine- and coarse-grained attention, where the fine-grained attention enables a token to directly attend to all the tokens of the bars most relevant to music structures, and the coarse-grained attention lets a token only attend to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them.
technical_features: 其他小节的总结信息（summary token）
technical_features_en: combination of fine- and coarse-grained attention
